subject: 해커스 수능영어독해 미니모의고사
title: 11회 9-10번 · 제목 파악하기 / 어휘 적절성 파악하기
fullPassage: As odd as it may be to hear, given our expectations, memories that we believe to be accurate and under our control sometimes seem to possess a mind of their own. Memory errors generally occur due to normal forgetfulness or more serious reasons like dementia and Alzheimer’s. There is one type of error, however, that has nothing to do with memory failures; this type involves a level of conviction in the validity of a memory or set of memories that aren’t actually true. This phenomenon, known as a false memory, is a distinct and detailed recollection of something never experienced in the first place. How these memories become lodged in the mind has been the subject of many studies, all of which have confirmed the existence of various avenues by which false memories may take root. The interference of existing knowledge and stored memories may contribute to developing false memories, and even something as innocuous as a suggestion can have an impact. In one experiment, the researcher was able to implant the memory of being lost in a shopping center during childhood in 25 percent of the participants by simply suggesting it. Misattribution can conjure up false memories as well. While some are harmless, such as believing you brought your umbrella when you left it at home, others can bring terrible consequences, like implicating a person in a crime who was never at the crime scene.
